title: Oozy Canadian Mushroom Bowl
description: A rich and indulgent Canadian dish featuring marsala wine and mushrooms, served in a stone bowl, perfect for a cold winter night. This shojin-friendly recipe is a hearty and satisfying meal.

ingredients.name: mushrooms
ingredients.notes: mixed varieties such as cremini and shiitake

instructions: Heat the olive oil in the stone bowl over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the mixed mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the marsala wine and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the mixture simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the thyme, vegetable broth, mustard, salt, and pepper.
Continue to simmer the mixture for an additional 5 minutes or until the liquid has reduced and the mushrooms are tender.
Serve the oozy mushroom mixture hot, straight from the stone bowl.
Garnish with fresh thyme and serve with crusty bread or over rice.
